# add gpg-suite

Add the `gpg-suite` cask — GPG Suite (GPG Mail, GPG Keychain, MacGPG), the GnuPG distribution used to sign commits and tags — to the Homebrew toolset. The original reference is the [cask page](https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/gpg-suite#default).
